summary: Corvex, Inc. filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for an at-the-market equity offering of up to $250,000,000 in common stock under an At-the-Market Sales Agreement with Chardan Capital Markets LLC as sales agent or principal. The filing names 2.5% compensation to Chardan. Shares are currently listed on Nasdaq Capital Market under symbol MOVE, with last reported price of $9.15 on October 13, 2026. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The offering is off a September 16, 2026 shelf registration.
